maintenance_led.reason: Revenue comes from developing and selling land and homes, hospitality and commercial leasing, not repair or servicing of installed assets.

publicly_funded.reason: Customers are private homebuyers, hotel guests, commercial tenants and developers; not government-paid.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows by developing its own Northwest Florida landholdings, Watersound communities, hotels and commercial properties, not by regular acquisitions.

mission_critical.reason: Homesites, hotel stays, and leased commercial space are discretionary real estate purchases; customers can choose other Florida properties or venues.
